response.sql: WITH matched_data AS (SELECT tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist, sf.shortintrt, sf.optvolrt FROM transactionrecord tr INNER JOIN sentimentandfundamentals sf ON sf.transref = tr.transreg), trans_averages AS (SELECT transreg, ordertypedist, AVG(shortintrt) as avg_shortintrt, AVG(optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt FROM matched_data GROUP BY transreg, ordertypedist), baseline_by_ordertype AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(shortintrt) as baseline_shortintrt FROM matched_data GROUP BY ordertypedist) SELECT ta.transreg, ta.ordertypedist, ta.avg_shortintrt, ta.avg_optvolrt, CASE WHEN ta.avg_shortintrt IS NOT NULL AND bl.baseline_shortintrt IS NOT NULL THEN ta.avg_shortintrt / bl.baseline_shortintrt ELSE NULL END as ratio FROM trans_averages ta LEFT JOIN baseline_by_ordertype bl ON ta.ordertypedist = bl.ordertypedist ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: AVG() in SQL ignores NULL values by default. When the request specifies 'ignoring missing values', this applies to null shortintrt and optvolrt values when computing transaction-level averages.
